## A form (in the page)

- **`First Name*` / `firstname`**: `text field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `FIRST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().firstName(...)`.
- **`Last Name*` / `lastname`**: `text field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `LAST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().lastName(...)`.
- **`Email*` / `email`**: `email field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **`Phone number` / `phone`**: `tel field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `PHONE_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().phoneNumber(...)`.
- **`Who are you? *` / `contact_type`**: `dropdown`. In `ContactUsElements` as `WHO_ARE_YOU_SELECT`: `enter().whoAreYou(option)`.
- **`Message`**: `text area`. In `ContactUsElements` as `MESSAGE_INPUT`: `enter().message(...)`.
- **`Please include your resume or preferred attachments` / `resume`**: `file field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `PLEASE_INCLUDE_YOUR_RESUME_INPUT`: `enter().pleaseIncludeYourResume(path)`.
- **`Submit`**: `button`. In `ContactUsElements` as `SUBMIT_BUTTON`: `click().submit()`.
